patch_description: This design keeps the useful direct-demand signal and sparse two-hop routing cues from the earlier programs, but changes how it models interactions. Two-hop alternatives are ranked as a normalized set, so a demand is not rewarded as though every plausible route carries all its traffic. Separately, a small number of positive couplings penalize pairs of links whose neighboring nodes have strongly overlapping traffic profiles. This adds a compact branch-diversity signal intended to discourage redundant choices without filling the QUBO with generic path couplings.
